notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Activate Dargo using Reckless Barbarian's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat from step 2.
